app.name: s-INK for Trello®
button.toolbar.name: s-INK for Trello
connect.title: Connect your Trello account
connect.intro: s-INK needs access to your Trello account to show your boards.
connect.step1: Open the Trello authorization page, sign in and press Allow.
connect.qrLabel: QR code of the Trello authorization page
connect.step2: Trello then displays a token: copy it and come back, s-INK detects it. Or press Paste token, or type it.
connect.step1Relay: Press Open in browser, or scan this code with your phone. Sign in to Trello and press Allow: s-INK then connects by itself.
connect.openTrelloDirectly: Open Trello’s page directly (you then copy the token yourself)
connect.step2Fallback: If the automatic connection does not work, open Trello’s page directly and copy the token it displays: s-INK detects it when you come back. Or press Paste token, or type it.
connect.tokenInvalid: This is not a Trello token yet ({count} characters): a token is made of 64 or more letters and digits, often starting with ATTA.
connect.clipboardEmpty: The clipboard is empty. Copy the token in the browser, then try again.
connect.clipboardUnavailable: The clipboard cannot be read on this device. Type the token below.
connect.persistTitle: Choose how long to stay connected
connect.sessionOnly: Recommended. The token is kept in memory only and never written on the tablet. s-INK stays connected while the tablet is on, even if you close and reopen it; after a restart, you connect again (a few seconds with the QR code).
connect.rememberWarning: s-INK stays connected after the tablet restarts. Warning: the token is then written unencrypted in the s-INK plugin folder. Anyone who can read this tablet’s files, including other plugins, could use it to access your Trello account. You can change this choice later in Settings; Disconnect deletes the token from the tablet and revokes it on Trello.
boards.title: s-INK for Trello: Boards
boards.loadFailed: Your boards could not be loaded.
boards.connectHint: See your boards here and turn your handwritten notes into Trello cards.
boards.roadmapFailedShort: Could not be opened. Try again.
settings.title: s-INK for Trello: Settings
settings.roadmapHelp: Supernote's official public board. It can be hidden, not removed.
settings.publicBoardHint: Link of a public Trello board (https://trello.com/b/…) or its 8-character ID
settings.publicBoardInvalid: This is not a Trello board link. It looks like https://trello.com/b/AbCd1234/name.
settings.publicBoardDuplicate: This board is already in the list.
settings.publicBoardNotFound: This board was not found, or it is not public.
settings.publicBoardNotPublic: This board is not public: anyone must be able to see it.
settings.showConnectCard: Show “Connect your Trello account” on the boards page
settings.showConnectCardHelp: Turn off if you only read public boards: the My boards section is then hidden. You can still connect from here.
settings.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect from Trello? You will need a new token to connect again.
settings.boardModeHelp: Boards open in this mode. The Supernote roadmap is always shown in full.
settings.linkTriggerHelp: A pen tap also leaves a dot in the note.
settings.aboutDescription: Read your Trello boards and add cards from your handwritten notes, on your Supernote.
settings.disclaimer: s-INK for Trello is an independent community project. It is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Trello, Inc., Atlassian or Ratta (Supernote). Trello® is a registered trademark of Atlassian; Supernote is a trademark of Ratta. Both are used here only to describe what the plugin works with.
storage.savedOnDevice: Your token is saved on this tablet.
storage.sessionOnly: Your token is not saved: you will need to connect again after the tablet restarts.
storage.saveFailed: The token could not be saved on this tablet. It is kept until the tablet restarts.
storage.writePermissionRationale: s-INK needs access to its own plugin folder to save and read your settings on this tablet.
error.missingApiKey: No Trello API key is configured in this build. See the README.
error.permissionDenied: Internet access was denied. Allow it so s-INK can reach Trello.
error.malformedToken: This does not look like a Trello token. Check what you typed.
error.invalidToken: Trello rejected the token. Generate a new one and try again.
error.network: Trello could not be reached. Check the Wi-Fi connection.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests to Trello. Wait a moment and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.browserUnavailable: No browser could be opened. Type the address on another device.
card.title: New Trello Card
card.noSelection: No text was found in the selection.
card.recognitionFailed: The handwriting in the selection could not be recognized.
card.noLists: This board has no open list.
card.name: Title
card.selectAgain: To try again, close this view, select the text with the lasso again and press “New Trello Card”.
card.filePermissionRationale: s-INK needs to read your notes to turn the lasso selection into a Trello card. Choose “Always allow” to avoid being asked again.
card.filePermissionDenied: Reading notes was not allowed, so the lasso selection cannot be read. Allow file access for s-INK in the plugin settings, then try again.
board.loadFailed: This board could not be loaded.
board.noLists: This board has no open list.
board.focusEmpty: No open card with a Focus tag is assigned to you on this board.
board.focusTagsHint: Choose the tags shown in Focus mode
board.focusTagsHelp: Focus mode shows the cards assigned to you, not marked complete, that carry at least one of the checked tags. With no tag checked, the tags are ignored.
board.focusTagsNone: No card of this board has a named tag.
board.reviewEmpty: No card is marked complete on this board.
cardDetail.loadFailed: The card detail could not be loaded.
inkLink.insertHint: Places a link to this page on the current note page. A finger tap on it opens it here.
